==Welcome to Librarybase!==
Welcome to Librarybase, the collaborative card catalog of everything. I am really happy you are here.

Here is some documentation about Librarybase you may find interesting:
* [[Project:Principles]] – what Librarybase is (not) setting out to do
* [[Project:Scope]] – subjects and entities in scope for the project
* [[Project:Provenance]] – data should come from a known place
* [[Project:Consensus]] – the default mode of decision making

Feel free to just get started editing – don't worry about making a mess or getting something wrong. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out on [[User talk:{{<includeonly>subst:</includeonly>REVISIONUSER}}|my talk page]]. ~~<includeonly>~~</includeonly><noinclude>~~</noinclude>
